notes.title: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona at Brutal Indies Unleashed 2025!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217845/9a20047baf7b433b9d44a7205e5ca2d25285f476.jpg[/img]  

The most violent, chaotic, and unapologetically brutal indie games are gathering at [b]Brutal Indies Unleashed 2025[/b] — and we’re thrilled to announce that [b]Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona[/b] is part of the lineup!  

Curated by ZlimBratSki, Brutal Indies Unleashed isn’t just another digital showcase. It’s a celebration of indie developers who embrace the art of combat, chaos, and digital destruction.  

What to expect:  
- 65 hand-picked brutal indie titles, including Skelethrone;  
- exclusive announcements and fresh gameplay reveals;  
- giveaways and appearances from popular content creators on ZlimBratSki’s YouTube channel;  
- a full-on atmosphere of chaos and destruction.  

[h3]Demo Version[/h3]  
The demo is temporarily available, but keep in mind — it’s no longer representative of the full version the game has become today.  
There’s also a prologue, [b]Skelethrone: The Prey[/b], which you can play to get a taste of the story.  

The game and DLC are currently discounted, but during the festival the discount won’t last long due to Steam’s time-limited sale rules.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2139840/Skelethrone_The_Chronicles_of_Ericona/  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499570/Skelethrone_The_Chronicles_of_Ericona__The_Jewel_in_the_Skull/  
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43909/Skelethrone_Complete_Edition/  

[h2]Publisher’s Info[/h2]
Discover even more projects that channel the same energy of chaos, brutality, and merciless battles:

[b]HMUR[/b] — a mad ride of speed and chaos inspired by the cult shooters of the ’90s. Playtests are now open, giving you the chance to be among the very first to dive into the carnage.  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499560/HMUR/

[b]Brotherhood[/b] — pure rage. A classic retro-shooter inspired by Wolfenstein 3D, where there’s no mercy and no allies. Just you, your shotgun, and endless hordes of enemies. Primal drive and the urge to destroy it all — that’s the kind of energy that connects Brotherhood to the spirit of brutal chaos.  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2635450/Brotherhood/

notes.title: NO MERCY RETRO FPS — Meet HMUR!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/db35c03d0fda7640f3f2aeb39b155175281e3729.jpg[/img]
Greetings to all old-school shooter fans!

Let us introduce HMUR — a fast-paced retro FPS that throws you into a twisted, alternative version of the Soviet Union in the 1990s. Combining the insane mechanics of 90s shooters, Soviet sci-fi aesthetics, and a pounding hardbass soundtrack, the game becomes a relentless dance of speed, precision, and madness.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499560/HMUR/"][/dynamiclink]
You are Sergey, an ordinary worker. Something went terribly wrong, and now your only chance to survive is to be faster than death. [p][/p][p]Be sure to watch the trailer: 
[previewyoutube=zVDyBBJkbxk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]PLAYTEST SIGN-UPS ARE NOW OPEN![/h2]
Want to be among the first to push HMUR to its limits? Sign up for the playtests right now on the game’s Steam page.  
When the playtests begin, you’ll receive a notification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/c230685cb4e8eca1cb8c821061c7c2fb03d15bc4.jpg[/img]

WHAT AWAITS PLAYTEST PARTICIPANTS:
[list]
[*] One life and endless restarts — in the spirit of Hotline Miami.
[*] Maximum mobility: dodge, jump, flank your enemies.
[*] Non-linear levels — choose your path and adapt your strategy on the fly.
[*] Huge arsenal — shotguns, assault rifles, heavy weapons. But ammo is worth its weight in gold.
[*] Original soundtrack — techno, hardbass, and breakcore merging with the firefight into a single rhythm.
[*] The atmosphere of a secret Soviet facility in the grip of disaster.
[/list]

[h2]🏆 EXCLUSIVE REWARD:[/h2]
Complete the playtest build — and earn an achievement. Upon release, it will turn into a golden pistol skin. This is not just a weapon, but a symbol that you survived where others gave up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/d722637b181d78f5ca45fba4570339a82a764422.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/76bdbfb56a930ee05fad6db4fb7d286628267475.jpg[/img]

[h3]HMUR is created by a solo developer.[/h3]
By participating in the playtests, each of you becomes part of the game’s development story. Join the [url=https://discord.gg/TbvXbvzZTZ]Discord[/url] and become part of the community.

notes.title: The Jewel in the Skull. Announcement of the new DLC and release date.
notes.notes:
Greetings!

All this time, I’ve been working hard on the first major [b]expansion[/b] for Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona.
And today, I’d like to share some details about what it brings, as well as its release date.

This is not just new content, but rather an organic integration of new storylines and world exploration within the main game.
You may have seen similar expansions in Bloodborne [spoiler](when will it finally come to PC?)[/spoiler] or, for example, in the Dark Souls series, where they significantly expand the base game.

[b][h2]Announcement of DLC The Jewel in the Skull.[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217845/85904ee924d473369c576b33cdd33c6709aed039.jpg[/img]
The world of Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona grows even darker and more mysterious!

Embark on a mysterious adventure where the shadows of the past intertwine with the threats of the present. You will venture into the labyrinth ship of the mad genius Mardek in search of a legendary artifact – “The Jewel in the Skull”. Using this artifact, you can enter the Ghost World and uncover the truth about Demagrass, the brother of Queen Aurora, whose fate is enshrouded in mystery and intrigue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217845/d249e46d77eaba57a75ca09f2d10ae08437b01ec.gif[/img]

Keep an eye out, though! Mardek's ship is not just an iron hulk, but a living nightmare where every step can be your last. Each step will lead you to dangerous traps, monsters, and mad scientists' experiments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217845/eba35d86f234ecd49613fa5a2ee1a1428501ca63.gif[/img]

[h3]The DLC will give you access to the following new content:[/h3]
You will have access to:
[list]
[*] 4 new biomes 
[*] More than 20 new enemies 
[*] 5 unique bosses 
[*] New weapons and equipment
[/list]

[h3]More details about the new weapons.[/h3]

[list]
[*] The expansion will introduce an entirely new weapon class to the game—knuckle dusters.
[/list]
There will be two knuckle dusters available, each featuring unique animations and effects.

notes.title: Boomstock event and "New Game+" announcement.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217845/dbc268b3591c83e7f27313ab4de9e33d6abb5bc8.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings, friends![/h3]
There are two good news that I would like to share with you today.

SKELETHRONE: The Chronicles of Ericona will be a part of the Boomstock Festival, an event dedicated to cool old-school action and retro games, organized by Fulqrum Publishing. Let's celebrate this event together!

Enjoy good discounts and demo versions on great games. You will also see announcements from different development teams at the festival.

[h3]I have an announcement for you too.[/h3]
A full-fledged [b]New Game+ mode[/b] has been [b]added[/b] to the game. You will be able to access the mode across all platforms.

But first things first. Let's check out the new trailer dedicated to the release of the new mode.

[previewyoutube=I3ARyI_v32w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Details:[/h3]
To start New Game+, after you have defeated the final boss, you need to open the bonfire menu and select "Start New Game+”. 
The New Game+ option is not available in patches prior to 1.3.3, so you will need to defeat the final boss, complete the game, and then be given the option to start a new game.
After that, even if you refuse, the bonfire menu will show the corresponding option.
As a reward for exploration, you'll receive crystals to improve your equipment instead of duplicates to avoid cluttering up your inventory.

Take advantage of the opportunity to upgrade your equipment by finding an anvil in the village of Singing Hills.
Available improvements with each new NG+:
[list]
[*] weapons: +5, +10, +15;
[*] gear: +5, +10;
[*] rings: +2, +3, +4, +5.
[/list]
When the NG+ is increased to +7, the characteristics of enemies and bosses will also grow, along with the amount of essence received.
All your inventory items, levels gained, Vessels of Healing, Sign of Change, Stone of Oblivion, Tree of Knowledge, and equipment improvement items will carry over to NG+.
We will only remove relics and quest items that affect the game's story and exploration.

notes.title: Caribbean Legend Patch 1.3 and Black Mark DLC!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/4a1a3a9e5a169d8bc75bce7cc840d9c3d88e5ba7.jpg[/img]
[h2]Ahoy![/h2]
The perfect moment to start playing Caribbean Legend!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230980/Caribbean_Legend/

[h3]First, the important stuff:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Patch 1.3 is available. We've never done anything like this before as a studio.
[*] Starting NG is not required. We recommend loading version 1.2.1 saves made while on land.
[*] Today marks the game's second 'release'—Steam will be actively promoting it for two weeks.
[*] To celebrate, we've set a historic low price—50% off.
[*] Now's the perfect moment to start playing if you’ve been holding off for any reason.
[*] Black Mark DLC is out now.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162620/Caribbean_Legend/

[h2]What's New:[/h2]
[h3]Ships[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/307e7522e668ce62f89348885e84606da24a1de1.jpg[/img]
One of the goals of Patch 1.3 was not only to rework the remaining player-favorite early-game ships but also to lay the groundwork for the planned boarding scenes. The ships turned out great.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/f9a4a0cea4b46e9f2b2a8c0803905c7c7730d88e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/bb92a57554e44b12040ec97b23b705dd42f743b5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/904dea0020e94ef30c83e5f96fd03e89ff0ad0c5.jpg[/img]

[b]New ships:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Valkyrie
[*] The Meifeng
[*] Fluyt
[*] War Schooner
[*] The Principio (DLC)
[*] Improved sail and rigging quality for all ships in the game.
[/list]
[b]In total, ~30% of the entire game fleet has been revamped by 1.3 - just as planned.

[/b]
[h3]Quests[/h3]
[b]Extinguished Star[/b]  
We’ve never created a quest this complex, non-linear, and intricate before. It has everything: new content with Mary and Helen, direct impact on the main storyline, cutscenes, crazy flashbacks, and valuable loot. The quest starts at the end of "The Dutch Gambit" and continues through to "Turtle Soup." No spoilers—see it for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/a472df15e0ab759ef50f801b5a45c4d4a545d29f.jpg[/img]
[b]Black Mark[/b]  
A non-linear quest, designed for the early stages of the game, offering valuable rewards and nods to veterans of the "Sea Dogs" series. Available in both Story and Sandbox modes. Part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162620/Caribbean_Legend/]"Black Mark" DLC[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/796fd6ecd8b2b719e464bd73408bc40d34bb7a73.jpg[/img]

Rewards include: a duelling double-barreled pistol, an Italian rapier, an Army broadsword, a Black Spot ward, armor, as well as a new officer—Tommy Irons, and the legendary Pink of Nicholas Sharp, the Principio. The Pink is stunning, but the true star of the DLC is Irons. He's got killer jokes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/d545d1771d658c07e40bc27ef4d1199bd431430d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Locations[/h3]
No new locations in this patch, aside from a few scenes for the Longway quest. The boarding decks took up almost all of our time and will continue to do so. All four decks will be included in either Patch 1.3.1 or 1.5.

However, we did update several old locations, especially those that significantly lagged behind the newer ones in quality.

[b]Locations update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Locations and scenes for the "Extinguished Star" quest
[*] The Old Lighthouse
[*] Port Royal Lighthouse
[*] Several beaches
[*] Indian village
[*] Improved ground textures in towns.
[/list]
[h3]Animations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/36b1932a71befa4a87eb7439eedaca35da3942c4.jpg[/img]

We continue the challenging journey of bringing quests, battles, and cities life to life. The minimum program has already been fulfilled, and with Patch 1.5, we aim for something even more ambitious. Next-gen is just around the corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/e4bdffc817a9eb257c9536c1644f9a512ff418fc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/32b3abee4fefa81358db7f09516da43afe7b9ac2.jpg[/img]

[b]New animations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Unique animations for the "Extinguished Star" quest
[*] 7 new contextual death battle animations
[*] 2 prayer animations in churches
[*] 2 animations for drunks in towns
[*] Tavern musicians no longer drown out the game’s music
[*] Fishermen, blacksmiths, and musicians now work according to the time of day
[/list]
[h3]New Hero[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/a375d3c2abd77a20c37084c2a8bc49aa3722312d.jpg[/img]
Due to popular demand, Helen McArthur is now a fully-fledged character in Sandbox mode. She is compatible with the "Vile Little God" and "Black Mark" DLCs. She has unique dialogues in her hometown Blueweld, unique achievements, loot, and starts her pirate career on a war schooner.

For now, she doesn’t carry a musket or visible armor, and there may be some "gender errors" :rofl_pirate: in the dialogues. Her development will continue in Patch 1.5, along with other Sandbox characters.

[h3]Notification System[/h3]
Traditionally, games in this series have never been known for being player-friendly or transparent, often requiring guides. What happened to my character? Why did I fail a dialogue check? What reward did I just receive? Any game needs to communicate with the player—and now Caribbean Legend does. [b]I consider this the key feature of Patch 1.3.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/c13339c8118c46e9dc4c5857f4806724ec1d7a87.jpg[/img]
[b]New notifications:[/b]
[list]
[*] Over 100 new format notifications on sea, land, and in dialogues
[*] Combat statuses—from poisonings to critical damage
[*] Loot markers—so far, only for plants in the jungle, but this is just the start
[*] Quest navigation—so far, only for the beginning of the game
[*] More quest markers over characters and on the global map
[*] New tutorial videos for core game mechanics
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/94b2f240c1ea990df3ecd70c7b5d4445dcb450c1.jpg[/img]
[h3]Interface[/h3]
Let’s be honest, we have the best interface. But somehow, the list of fixes for it has already stretched to three pages. :rofl_pirate: The first half of the first page finally made it into Patch 1.3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/03c9e371fad5d3f361d9cb22e92d78fd4914f051.jpg[/img]
[b]UI update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlimited key remapping—adjust the controls to your liking
[*] Control hints in loot, trade, and exchange windows
[*] Highlighting new entries in the ship’s log and documents
[*] Highlighting available skill points for characters
[*] Keeping the selected character when switching tabs between inventory and skills
[*] Displaying character roles in officer assignment windows
[*] Improved interaction with items in the inventory
[*] Added a DLC button in the menu—if all are purchased, it will be inactive
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/9ff765df6a71eb6a95e65d2b94ca236c3265bc56.jpg[/img]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] 13 achievements
[*] New ward
[*] New sword
[*] Automatic crash reports sending - let's see how bad it really is out there
[*] Longway can now carry muskets
[*] New dialogue camera
[*] Missing textures restored for some objects in the "Flying the Jolly Roger" quests
[*] Claude Durand now reliably triggers his loyalty event after a set time
[*] Obtaining a patent removes pirates from the crew
[*] Reputation no longer drops if the player exits "Flying the Jolly Roger" questline before Cartagena
[*] Fewer soldiers in towns, and they stop the player less often
[*] Chance to deceive the guards can no longer exceed 90%
[*] Governors no longer ask you to infiltrate friendly towns
[*] Passengers no longer ask to be taken to hostile towns
[*] "Iron Will" perk no longer allows intimidating officers
[*] Missing item descriptions—skill bonuses, etc.—have been added
[*] Additional optimization of the tutorial on Martinique
[*] Spelling and grammar corrections - thanks to all reports you have been sharing on Discord
[*] Numerous bug fixes
[*] Improved overall game stability
[/list]
[h2]1.5[/h2]
That’s all for now! Over the past six months, we’ve done an incredible amount of work together. We’ve done everything possible and even more. Except for the Story mode epilogue, of course.

We could have done it already, but it would have been too... simple? I want to create something special and worthy of Charles de Maure's story—call it a "director’s cut" of his storyline, if you will. Plus, the game has long needed list of truly new mechanics, fixes for old ones, a complete rebalance, a new loot category, and a proper uplift of Sandbox mode. Not to mention improved controls, gamepad support, Steam Deck experience.

Patch 1.5 will take at least six months, and it will definitely require starting the new game. So for now, we’ll take a short break, rest, and then get back to work.

[b]Leave reviews ːsteamthumbsupː as blue as the Caribbean Sea, download the patch, buy [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162620/Caribbean_Legend/]the DLC[/url]—and if you’ve been putting off playing the game for any reason, now’s the perfect moment to start![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/9e147e48b319ff4dea3cec3417f5b4966fdf2de1.png[/img]
[i]Coming soon...[/i]

:jollyr:

notes.title: Release date postponement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217845/b3f2b78814363f088bb6cce1474dcc7a512ca34b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hey there, friends![/h3]

[h3]Together with the publisher, we decided to [b]delay the release until Q3 of this year.[/b][/h3]

Ultimately, this will ensure that everyone has the best gaming experience, and more time can be devoted to tweaks, changes, and updates.

There was a lot of feedback from new players who tried the demo version for the first time and from those who compared the prologue and demo version. Thanks to this feedback it was possible to understand all the weaknesses of the game. Therefore, it will take time to improve some aspects of gameplay.

For starters, I have decided to overhaul the talent tree. Make it more diverse.

Now if you follow a particular leveling path you will get special talents that fit your gameplay style. Here is an example:

Blunt - Increases the effectiveness of blunt and crushing weapons.
Blades - Increases the effectiveness of short swords and daggers.
Ammo -  Increases the number of charges for ranged weapons.
Shields - Reduces stamina expenditure when blocking a blow with a shield.
Two-handed - Reduces stamina consumption when using a two-handed weapon.

This is how the updated talent tree looks like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217845/db48fa857d39f3797040c09884987cd361fd3c6d.png[/img]

This is just a small portion of what we have planned. In the coming days, I'll share with you how the polishing process is going. Stay tuned and see you soon!

Best wishes,
70`Strike and the Valkyrie Initiative team

notes.title: The Creator of Makh-Abyss world
notes.notes:
Greetings, Eternal Wanderers!
I would like to share with you today how the universe of Mah-Abyss came to exist, as well as the being responsible for its creation.

[h3]Margoss. [/h3]
From the depths of the universe he came, tired of endless wandering, a titan and beholder determined to construct his own world - an Ideal Utopia on the edge of the Milky Way. This world is now known as the Mach-Abyss.

This world was ruled by order and harmony centuries before the events of our story. An ideal world without flaws. As in many realms, nothing lasts forever. An unforeseen error makes the harmony tumble into chaos when strange beings appear whose code differs from everything else in this world.

In the course of time, the Titan fell into a thousand-year slumber. The Red Comet manifested itself into this world, which marked the birth of one who would later come to be known as the Creator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217845/66317621a4da7a17961a2b58b4f2ef30fb8e90d8.gif[/img]

Using aether flows, he created amazing yet terrifying miracles, such as the Crystal Tower that appeared out of nowhere, being a vivid proof of his mastery. Consequently, people began to believe in Gods that never existed. Eventually the Creator usurped the world. While Margoss slept, the world he created, slipped into obscurity.

[b]How do you like the demo version, by the way?[/b].
Please share your impressions in the comments or in the community center on Steam

notes.title: Welcome to the Makh-Abyss world.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217845/370d5ebfd64d122354b92905b8b6317e5f4815df.png[/img][b]Hello friends!  [/b]

I think now is a good time to introduce you to our game in detail. This includes how it was conceived, its prerequisites and inspirations, as well as its lore and inhabitants. Seeing so many enthusiastic people like you looking forward to the release of this game is wonderful. Ksayfar is my nickname; I am the developer of Skelethrone, and I am starting a Developer Diary.

[b]Welcome to the Makh-Abyss world.[/b]

Michael John Moorcock. Many are familiar with the name, while others are hearing it for the first time. As a fan of his Eternal Champion books, I was inspired to create this world. He is a superb (at least in my opinion) English writer of heroic fantasy.

During the height of the pandemic in February 2020, I (like many others in this world) isolated myself. In the middle of a cold winter night, I was conquering another adventure (for the umpteenth time). A sudden thought flashed across my mind; why don't I make a game? This was the right time to do something like this. Despite my lack of experience in game development, my artistic and musical abilities were not lacking. The only thing I had to do was learn how to work with the game engine. Almost half a year later, the first prototype was ready. As I had several variations of the game's main character, I decided he would be absolutely neutral in his quest for victory, as he is neither good nor evil. That's how the Skeleton came to be.

My story will continue soon, but for now, you can check out the updated trailer to the Prologue.
